name: CoCo Fresh Tea & Juice
tagline: The Undisputed Philippine Office Group-Order Champion
whyChosen: Best overall variety, reliable high-volume group ordering on Grab/Foodpanda, caters to non-caffeine, milk tea fans, and fruity citrus lovers alike.

mustTry.name: 3 Buddies Milk Tea
mustTry.description: Rich Taiwan milk tea loaded with silky pudding, grass jelly, and chewy pearls.
mustTry.iconicReason: CoCo's all-time #1 best-seller in Manila offices; maximum texture in one cup.

mustTry.name: Panda Milk Tea
mustTry.description: Signature milk tea with a duo of black boba and translucent white agar pearls.
mustTry.iconicReason: Crisp chewiness, lighter texture than standard boba.

mustTry.name: Passion Fruit Tea Burst
mustTry.description: Tangy fresh passion fruit tea loaded with pearls and nata de coco.
mustTry.iconicReason: Incredible afternoon refresher to combat tropical Manila afternoon heat.

mustTry.name: Taro Milk Tea with Sago
mustTry.description: Creamy earthy taro milk infused with tiny chewy sago pearls.

name: Tiger Sugar
tagline: Pioneers of the Brown Sugar Milk Mousse Wave
whyChosen: Iconic 'tiger stripe' aesthetic with warm, slow-cooked dark brown sugar pearls and rich cream mousse topping.

mustTry.name: Brown Sugar Boba Milk with Cream Mousse
mustTry.description: Warm caramelized boba drenched in fresh cold milk and velvety cream mousse.
mustTry.iconicReason: The global benchmark for brown sugar fresh milk drinks.

mustTry.name: Roasted Boba Tea Latte
mustTry.description: Roasted oolong tea base blended with fresh milk and boba.
mustTry.iconicReason: Deals with the sweetness by offering fragrant roasted tea notes.

name: The Alley (Lujiaoxiang)
tagline: Artisanal Handmade Deerioca Pearls & Premium Teas
makatiLocations: One Bonifacio High Street (Delivers to Makati)
whyChosen: Handcrafted tapioca pearls kneaded and boiled for 2 hours, paired with elegant tea aromas.

mustTry.name: Brown Sugar Deerioca Crème Brûlée
mustTry.description: Signature Deerioca pearls layered with fresh milk and torched crème brûlée custard.
mustTry.iconicReason: Indulgent dessert in a cup, extremely rich and velvety.

mustTry.name: Royal No. 9 Milk Tea
mustTry.description: Black tea infused with blueberries and sweet milk.
mustTry.iconicReason: Distinctive floral-fruity scent unique to The Alley.

name: Gong Cha
tagline: Royal Tea Craftsmanship & Iconic Milk Foam
whyChosen: Famous for their dense, savory salted cream cheese milk foam on freshly brewed single-origin teas.

mustTry.name: House Special Milk Wintermelon Tea
mustTry.description: Naturally sweet wintermelon tea crowned with signature savory milk froth.
mustTry.iconicReason: Classic Taiwanese favorite that requires zero added sugar.

mustTry.name: Earl Grey Milk Tea with 3Js
mustTry.description: Fragrant bergamot earl grey tea with grass jelly, pudding, and pearls.
mustTry.iconicReason: High-tea sophistication combined with triple chewy toppings.

name: Chicha San Chen (吃茶三千)
whyChosen: Custom high-pressure Teapresso machines extract each cup from raw leaves on the spot. Top-tier luxury office treat.

mustTry.name: Fresh Taro Boba Milk Tea
mustTry.description: Real mashed Taiwanese Dajia taro paste, handmade pearls, and fresh milk.
mustTry.iconicReason: Voted by milk tea connoisseurs as the smoothest authentic taro in Manila.

mustTry.name: Dong Ding Oolong Fresh Milk Tea
mustTry.description: Award-winning iTQi superior taste medal roasted oolong with slow-cooked honey boba.
